title: Unsafe Functions and Soundness
goal: Declare unsafe functions and build safe, sound wrappers around them.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unsafe Rust

sections.text: Marking a function as `unsafe` tells callers that they must uphold safety preconditions.

sections.caption: The unsafe keyword moves responsibility to the caller.

sections.text: Calling an `unsafe` function requires an `unsafe` block at the call site.
Inside an `unsafe fn`, performing unsafe operations still requires an explicit `unsafe` block in modern Rust.

sections.caption: Unsafe operations inside unsafe functions need explicit blocks.

sections.text: A safe function wrapping unsafe code is sound only if no possible input can cause undefined behavior.

explanation: Declare unsafe functions and build safe, sound wrappers around them.
